project_type: pnpm monorepo - Express 5 API server + React Vite SPA
build_system: pnpm workspaces with esbuild (API) and vite (frontend)
test_framework: No test framework found in the project
build_command: pnpm run build (root level, runs typecheck then builds all packages)
verification_instructions: Verify all deployment files are syntactically valid and reference the correct paths. No runtime tests available.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js 24 and pnpm available on sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Use pnpm only (preinstall script blocks npm/yarn). Build with esbuild for API, vite for frontend.
key_patterns: API serves on /api path (Express router). Frontend is a SPA built to artifacts/creatools/dist/public/. API requires PORT and DATABASE_URL env vars. Frontend requires PORT and BASE_PATH env vars at build time. Startup.ts runs additive migrations automatically. API uses pino logger. Domains: creatools.co (main), creatools.stream (overlay links), creatools.live (profile pages) - all same app, routing handled by frontend based on hostname.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm monorepo. artifacts/api-server/ = Express API (builds to dist/index.mjs). artifacts/creatools/ = React SPA (builds to dist/public/). lib/db/ = Drizzle ORM schemas. lib/api-zod/ and lib/api-client-react/ = shared API types. scripts/ = maintenance scripts. CNAME = app.creatools.co.
